description: Roll back the most recently committed changeset from its journal: modified files are restored byte-for-byte, files it created are deleted. Call repeatedly to step back through earlier commits. Edits made to those files after the commit are overwritten too. Refused while a changeset is open (while one is open, reads reflect its staged edits and nothing is on disk until commit). The RPG Maker editor must stay closed while the server edits the project.
name: undo_changeset
title: Undo last changeset
